title: Isolating the compressed swap timing tool
headline: Both kernels completed the compressed-swap diagnostic with exactly one verified decompression for every timed page. The shared library also passed the functional rerun.

sections.title: Why time compressed swap
sections.lead: A memory page can be stored as a smaller compressed copy. Restoring it takes work, so the experiment measures how long the application waits.

blocks.text: The shared library moves compression and storage code behind one interface. The experiment tests whether existing behavior survives the change.

sections.title: Where compressed swap operates
sections.lead: An application reads a page that is no longer resident in working memory.

sections.title: What the timing observer sees
sections.lead: A return probe reports successful decompression for the benchmark process.

sections.title: Keep the timing tool resident
sections.lead: The original trace identified the process. It did not record a page address for either return. The repair keeps the tool's non-target mappings resident and leaves the test region available to swap.

sections.title: What remains to test
sections.lead: The full comparison needs repeated calibration plus matched runs for the compressed and physical paths. It needs more guest attempts than remain in the original budget.

blocks.text: Independent XSwap still needs its guest driver and physical-path validation. A platform review interrupted the driver work. The pressure-driven migration test starts after independent XSwap passes correctness.

patches.takeaway: Free compressed objects through the shared library

results_lead: The old timing tool saw two decoder returns for one timed access. With the tool's own memory pinned, the baseline and the shared-library kernel each completed the sequential and shuffled reads with full data checks.
results_detail: The timing tool verified that its own mappings stayed locked and the target range stayed unlocked. Neither run lost or missed a probe. One run per kernel shows the measurement path works and leaves the speed difference unmeasured.

chart.takeaway: Every timed read had a verified decompression
